product.summary: App-based Tangem self-custody wallet that does not require a Tangem card or ring and stores encrypted wallet data in the phone security environment.
product.notes: Kept separate from the Tangem hardware wallet because its private-key storage and recovery boundary is the smartphone rather than a Tangem secure element. Launch date is established by the reviewed February 27, 2026 first-party Tangem Mobile Wallet release event and official Tangem blog evidence.

events.title: Tangem Mobile Wallet launched
events.description: Tangem introduced the Mobile Wallet as a free self-custody wallet available directly inside the Tangem app, with encrypted wallet keys stored in the smartphone security environment rather than a Tangem card or ring.

evidence.title: Wallet Types: Mobile vs Hardware
evidence.notes: Primary source separating Mobile Wallet from hardware card/ring wallet and describing their different key-storage boundaries.

evidence.title: What is the Tangem Mobile Wallet
evidence.notes: Primary launch source stating the Mobile Wallet was available that day in the latest Tangem app and describing smartphone-based key storage.
